info.name: Create a return (MODELED path; operation name CONFIRMED)

items.docs: Creates a return in the Parcel Perform account against an existing outbound shipment. Only one return may be created per request. Confirmed via the "Create a Return" / "Create Return" documentation page titles; exact path and payload are modeled.

info.name: Create a return with its return shipment (MODELED path; operation name CONFIRMED)

items.docs: Creates a Return and its associated Return Shipment together in a single request. Confirmed via the "Create a Return" documentation page title (which pairs Create Return with Create Shipment); exact path and payload are modeled.
